rec.name: PDP Payment Bar with Installment / Invoice Message
rec.status: Built — launched (first variant only; dynamic Klarna on-site messaging variant not built)

what.text: A payment-trust block placed directly under the Add to Cart button on the product page. It shows a row of selectable payment-method icons (PayPal, Mastercard, Visa, Amex, Klarna, Apple Pay, Sofort, etc.) on a configurable background, followed by a centered one-line installment/invoice message with a Klarna or PayPal logo (e.g. 'Bequem auf Rechnung zahlen'). The same styling and code is shared with the cart page so it is not built twice.

why.text: Showing familiar payment logos right at the point of commitment reduces payment anxiety and signals legitimacy. Highlighting buy-now-pay-later or pay-by-invoice lowers the perceived upfront cost and financial risk, which helps price-sensitive shoppers and higher-ticket items convert.

how.text: Create two snippets: 'ed-payment-bar' (loops through checkbox settings and outputs Shopify payment_type_svg_tag icons in a flex row with space-between) and 'ed-klarna-custom-payment' (Klarna or PayPal logo plus configurable text, centered). Add a 'Styling of payment bar' group to config/settings_schema.json with background color, border style (rounded/square), grayscale vs colorful icons, per-icon checkboxes (recommend max 6 active), PDP/cart toggles for the rate-payment line, payment method select, text, text color, and font size. Render both snippets in a wrapper div 'ed-payment-bar-pdp' beneath the add-to-cart button in the product template; the rate line is wrapped in a settings.show_rate_payment_pdp condition. The same snippets are reused in the cart with a 'ed-payment-bar-cart' wrapper.

items: Checkboxes per payment icon: PayPal, Mastercard, Visa, Amex, Klarna, Apple Pay, Klarna Pay Later, Sofort, Bitcoin, Shopify Pay (max ~6 recommended)
Toggle: show rate/invoice line on PDP
Toggle: show rate/invoice line on cart
Rate payment logo: Klarna or PayPal
Rate payment text (default 'Bequem auf Raten zahlen')
Font size (10–40px, single value; separate mobile/desktop sizes requested as improvement)

dependencies.text: Theme access to edit config/settings_schema.json and the product/cart templates (no metafields; not doable by non-devs). Shopify payment_type_svg_tag / payment_type_img_url filters. The dynamic installment amount variant (e.g. 'Pay over 3 interest-free payments of 19,97 € with Klarna') requires the Klarna On-site Messaging app and could not be hard-coded. Documented in Slite and the Pitch product catalog.

images.caption: Final built variant: black Add to Cart button, row of payment icons (PayPal, Mastercard, Visa, Amex, Klarna, Apple Pay, Sofort), and centered 'Klarna. Bequem auf Rechnung zahlen' line underneath.
Reference design with dynamic Klarna on-site messaging ('Pay over 3 interest-free payments of 19,97 € with Klarna. Learn more') — not built, depends on the Klarna app.
